articles.title: Windows Active Directory RCE and DoS Vulnerabilities Put Windows Systems at Risk
articles.summary:

articles.title: Notion AI Data Breach Exposes Customer Chat Transcripts After Third-Party Fireworks AI Cyberattack
articles.summary:
Notion has confirmed that a cyberattack against its AI infrastructure provider, Fireworks AI, exposed customer chat transcripts affecting fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces. The company said its own systems were not breached and no other Notion features were affected. Impacted customers received notifications on November 9, 2026, while the investigation remains ongoing. articles.title: Railway Security Breach Exposes Customer API Keys, Database Passwords and Cloud Secrets
articles.summary:
Railway has reported a security incident after noticing unusual activity in systems that store customer environment variables. An unauthorized third party may have accessed encrypted variables and obtained decrypted content for some values, potentially exposing API keys, database passwords, and private registry credentials. articles.title: Critical SAP PROXYGATE and ICM2SHELL Vulnerabilities Allow Server Takeover Without Authentication
articles.summary:

Discovered by Onapsis Research Labs and disclosed on November 10, 2026, all three carry CVSS scores of 10.0. The fixes arrived during November’s security updates.
